schema: opt_core.attn.pair_fused cell table v1. rows[]: impl (fpf|lnl) x piece (prologue|epilogue|transition|ln_linear|gate_transpose|fused_transition) x key (prologue (C,H,D); epilogue (C_out,H,D); transition/fused_transition (C, n*C hidden); ln_linear (C,); gate_transpose (H*D,)) x cc ('M.m' compute capability) x triton ('M.m' or '*' = any) -> variant (which carried kernel serves: fpf prologue v3 | prologue_v4 (fpf_glue_v2) | mkpf_f1 (fpf_mkpf, ln='fused' only; cfg carries ln_arith + fma_flags) | v3_fp32z (v3 kernel, fp32 pair tensor, LN in-kernel); epilogue v2 | epilogue_v3 (fpf_glue_v2); transition v2_fold (fpf_transition_v2: row mask + residual folded in the kernel, in place allowed; served only for a caller that names it: transition(..., variants=('v2_fold', 'v1'))) | v1 | v1_fp32x (fp32 input) | transition_v3 (fpf_glue_v2)); PF.tri_attn_block/transition(variant=None|'<name>'|{piece: name}) pins a variant ('no-cell:variant:<name>' when it has no servable row) + cfg (the pinned launch configuration passed to the kernel) + status (certified = served; candidate = served only under OPT_CORE_PF_ALLOW_CANDIDATE=1, i.e. qualification jobs) + evidence (what qualified it: the kit's own check of the carried bytes or a core coverage run). Resolution: exact (cc,triton) rows before (cc,'*') rows; first matching row in file order wins. named_off[]: impl x piece x key ('*' = any) x cc ('*' = any) [x variant] -> the keys the measured compositions run with the lever OFF (no measured cell there; 'off' = not-measured | slower, 'evidence' says who meets it): resolution answers them 'no-cell:...+off(<off>)' and the caller's stock statements serve them by name; a candidate row not admitted is the named-off entry of its own key (its 'off' field, default not-measured). Any OTHER key without a servable row is UNKNOWN and engages the lever's SAFE settings for the capability (opt_core.kernels.safe_settings) or an lnl piece's default settings, named once per process; 'no-cell:...' alone remains where no safe settings admit the shape. dtype served: bf16 activations everywhere (fp32 LN statistics in-kernel).

exact_rows.rule: the EXACT construction (impl fpf, ln='stock': the caller's LayerNorm output projected in ONE summation order) equals the stock Linear layers' cuBLAS bf16 GEMMs bit for bit only where cuBLAS keeps that order on the card. Per compute capability: below pieces.<piece>.min_rows rows cuBLAS takes another order; every call of max_rows rows and more is worked in pieces of piece_rows rows, the full pieces keeping the served order and the remainder piece (rows mod piece_rows) served only within [min_remainder, piece_rows - top_margin]. Calls outside are refused BY NAME before any launch (Unsupported 'exact-rows:below_min_rows' | 'exact-rows:above_max_rows'; attn.pair_fused.exact_rows_word); the caller's stock statement answers them. ln='fused' (tolerance class) is never affected; a card absent here keeps one order at every row count (cc 9.0: bitwise 20..2048 tokens in kernels/transition's exact vouch). pieces: 'transition' = the fused pair transition (measured at (C, hidden) = (128, 512) and (64, 128)); 'prologue' = the fused triangle-attention block, prologue q|k|v|g|bias + epilogue W_o projections (measured at (C, H, D) = (128, 4, 32)). rows = the call's leading dimensions flattened (a pair call [B, N, N, C] is B*N*N rows; an N-token input's pair stack runs at N*N rows). The rule applies on every stack of the card until a stack records its own band (refusing is byte-safe; the lower remainder margin is the smallest remainder MEASURED identical, remainders 8,209..161,423 unmeasured).
